Tilefit

Tilefit, a single-player block puzzle for Android. Built and signed by the release workflow of https://github.com/jpsutton/tilefit.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://jpsutton.github.io/tilefit/fdroid/repo
